ANGRAU Young Professional - I Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ANGRAU Young Professional - I Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ANGRAU Young Professional - I recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Young Professional - I post at ANGRAU is scheduled for 18 August 2026. Candidates should report on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional - I post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a 4 years Bachelor's Degree in Agriculture from an ICAR accredited University/college to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Young Professional - I position?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/Woman candidates.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, there is a relaxation of 5 years in the upper age limit for candidates belonging to SC, ST, and Woman categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional - I post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview in person with all required documents.

faq.question: Q7. What documents are required for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring their bio-data, original certificates for verification, and a set of Xerox copies of documents related to date of birth, educational qualifications, and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Acharya N. G. Ranga Agricultural University, Nandyal, Andhra Pradesh, 518502.

faq.question: Q9. Is prior experience mandatory for the Young Professional - I post?
faq.answer: While a Bachelor's degree in Agriculture is mandatory, experience in field observations, farmers meetings, computer knowledge, statistical analysis, documentation, and report writing is preferable but not strictly mandatory.

faq.question: Q10. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Young Professional - I post under the AICRP on IFS "Pilot project on crop diversification" at ANGRAU.
